notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other nontoken creatures.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four other nontoken creatures, adding four mana of any color(s).
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers four times, exiling the sacrificed creatures from your graveyard.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prowling Geistcatcher.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning all creature cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.
